title: Catch up branches with their target
summary: Mugetsu spots the local branches that would rebase onto their target without a conflict and catches them up in one go, without touching your checkout.

features.title: Catch up branches automatically
features.body: After every reload, each local branch is replayed in memory onto its target (its open PR's base, else the trunk). A badge on Branches counts the ones that rebase cleanly; pick them from the keyboard (arrows, P, S, space, ⌘/Ctrl+Enter) and they are rebased one by one without a checkout, pushed ones force-pushed with lease. Stacks go parent first.

improvements.title: Clear reason when a push is refused
improvements.body: If someone pushed to a branch meanwhile, the catch-up puts it back and says why under the branch.
